description.en: Progressive-disclosure MCP gateway for DeepSeek Harness: it keeps two model-facing tools, reveals ranked exact remote input schemas on demand, then calls an explicit server/tool pair.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的渐进式披露 MCP 网关：保持两个面向模型的工具，按需返回排序后的远端精确 inputSchema，再调用明确的 server/tool。
